assessment.rationale: The answer turns advice about one specific passage into a general rule for any quarter-note main note. It also drops the condition that the grace note has no slash and says the grace note is divided, when the source says the main note is divided. It drops the hedge '대부분' and presents the writer's opinions without attribution, so the advice is not clearly marked as the source's view.
